metas.name: AH48 Waystone
metas.note: The waystone which says "AH48" can be found on the road from the Indian border all the way up to Thimphu.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Bhutan white pine
metas.note: The Bhutan white pine (pinus bhutanica) acan be found most commonly in the red spots.
metas.footer: Credit to Duskron for the Himalayas Conifer Tree Guide

metas.name: Blue Himalayan pine
metas.note: The Blue (Himalayan) pine is generally only found in the center or west of the country.
metas.footer: Credit to Duskron for the Himalayas Conifer Tree Guide

metas.name: Buddha
metas.note: That's the buddha statue you can sometimes see in Thimphu.
metas.footer: Credit to habibz and chat for their Geo Book

metas.name: Bumthang Airport
metas.note: The Bumthang Airport in Jakar is located in a wet valley.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Car Meta - black object
metas.note: On the road going up to Trashigang, you can see a grey/black object poking out of the right side of the car.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - black stick
metas.note: In this section, you can see a black stick poking out the left part of the car.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - diagonal lines
metas.note: Inbetween Wangdue Phodrang and Trongsa, you can find white diagonal lines on the back of the car.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - hook
metas.note: In and around the town of Ha, you can see a hook on the car. It will be very blurred, with only the top being visible.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - small circle
metas.note: Between the town of Samkhang and (roughly) the border between Sarpang and Zhemgang district, you can see a very small circle on the right side of the car.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - white dots
metas.note: On this part of the road, you can find two white dots on the back of the car; a bigger one, and a smaller one.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - white stripe
metas.note: In pink, the parts where you'll find a white stripe on the left side of the car.
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: Car Meta - white thing on the left
metas.note: Between Gelephu and Samkhara, you will find this white thing on the left side of the car,
metas.footer: Credit to @mrpotota_ for this meta.

metas.name: DR46, DR47
metas.note: On this road heading up towards Lhuntse, you can find waystones saying either "DR46" or "DR47".
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Flat
metas.note:
If you find yourself in a noticeably flat location, you might just be in the south. In fact, that'll almost certainly be where you are.

Coverage here is limited to the towns of Phuntsholing, Sarpang, Gelephu and Samdrup Jongkhar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Fog 1
metas.note: The most notable place you can find fog is around Gedu.
metas.footer: Credit to habibz and chat for their Geo Book

metas.name: Fog 2
metas.note: If you see lots of fog, or find yourself in a place you'd run into lots of the aforementioned fog, and you're not on the road to Thimphu, you're likely not too far south of Galechugaon.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Gelephu airport
metas.note: Gelephu airport is the only airport located in the flat south of the county, making it recognizable.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Gelephu pebble road
metas.note: If you find yourself on flat terrain, on a pebbled road such as this, you're in Gelephu. (Not city center though)
metas.footer: Credit to habibz and chat for their Geo Book

metas.name: Late sunset coverage
metas.note:
"Late sunset coverage can be found in two places in the country; on a small rural sideroad in the east of Mongar District and in a significantly more urban area around the town of Paro in the west."

  • Plonkit
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: NH2 Waystone
metas.note: The NH2 is this whole northern thing. It seems like.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: NH4 Waystone
metas.note: On this road you'll find the waystone saying "NH4".
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Palms
metas.note: You'll sometimes see palms in the southern parts of the country. (Not just the towns in the south)
metas.footer: Credit to habibz and chat for their Geo Book

metas.name: Paro Airport
metas.note: This airport will be found in a dry northwest valley.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Philippines pavement
metas.note: If you see concrete pavement reminiscent of the Philippines, you're in this extension of Phuentsholing.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Phobjika valley
metas.note: The Phobjika valley is a wide, relatively flat agricultural valley. It's the largest open valley without a river on Street View.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Pines
metas.note: In the north, you're going to see pines. You can see a lot of them, all over the mountains.
metas.footer: Credit to habibz and chat for their Geo Book

metas.name: Recognizable road
metas.note: One of, if not the best meta for Bhutan, is that you will always see solid white lines on the outside, on the road going up to Thimphu. Moreover, the quality of the road in comparison to other roads is also noticeable.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: www.plonkit.net/bhutan.

metas.name: Road work vibe
metas.note: This section of the road can feel like road work is in progress, or have a road work vibe, with lots of rocks lying next to the road, and a bunch of sand. Additionaly, you can almost always see a river to the same side of the road in this section.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Sikkim Fir
metas.note: Sikkim Fir (Abies Densa) can be found in quite a few places, but a high concentration of them should lean you towards Phrumsengla national park. More specifically, northwest of Sengor.
metas.footer: Credit to Duskron for the Himalayas Conifer Tree Guide

metas.name: SL1 Waystone
metas.note: When encountering an SL1 Waystone, it should put you on the SL1.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: SL2 Waystone
metas.note: In the red circle, the area where SL2 waystones should be found.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: SL4 Waystone
metas.note: The SL4 Waystone can be found on this road. You have more chance of seeing a waystone with the SL4 on it in the red part.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: SNH Waystone
metas.note: SNH Waystones are found on the road from Trashigang to Trashiyangtse in the north.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.

metas.name: Unique kerb
metas.note: This kerb, with grey sections seperated by a bit of white, is characteristic for the road leading up to Thimphu. Also, (roughly) between Chimaka and Chapcha, the average length of the grey section tends to be a little smaller, making it look a bit more like a square.
metas.footer: Check out www.plonkit.net/bhutan for more clues.
